I want to flip houses, make mud kitchens, flip furniture, paint large canvases, be a piano teacher, work at a restaurant, be a YouTube creator, go back to working at the grocery store that i did in my 20s, start a band, create party boxes for kids, be a maths professor at university, do I do a PhD?   Do I go back to civil engineering?  Should I become a property developer?  
I get so much anxiety when people ask me “what do you do?”.   I start blabbering on downplaying everything I’ve ever achieved. The other person doesn’t know what I’m talking about lol. 
This video just revealed everything about me to a T.  I keep trying to force myself to pick one lane. But this video showed me there’s another way to embrace who I am but keep moving forward.
